name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_goal) makes reaching the goal a hard requirement, and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) puts the key pickup before it. That chain already forces has_key, so no Existence(has_key) is added. The door opening needs no clause because the environment requires it before at_goal and the task does not state it.

texts: The agent must reach the goal cell (at_goal) at least once during the episode.
The agent must pick up the yellow key (has_key) before it reaches the goal: the goal must not be reached before the key is held.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
